answer: Pay in notes, not coin: a note redeems 25% of face for one holder, 100% after four independent hands. Each hop needs the receiver's signature and a small proof-of-work; hops among keys sharing a funding root or host count once. A thousand clones cash a quarter of face, the clones' own keys adding no diversity; par means handing real value to strangers at every hop, at a loss. Honest earners reach par by hiring a stranger once. A violet passed among a thousand petals of one plant smells of one garden; nectar sweetens only between flowers, and a comet stuck in its own orbit is just rock.
